english.title: Fail to return private hire / hackney carriage Identity plate or disc within 7 days of service of notice to do so
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the proprietor of a

(A)_[hackney carriage]_
(B)_[private hire vehicle]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), licensed by **(..SPECIFY DISTRICT COUNCIL..), failed without reasonable excuse to comply with the terms of a notice served on you on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..), requiring you to return to them within seven days of that notice the

(C)_[plate]_
(D)_[disc]_

which was

(E)_[required to be affixed to the carriage as mentioned in section 38 of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847]_
(F)_[issued for the vehicle under section 48(5) of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 58(2) of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the proprietor of a hackney carriage or private hire vehicle
failed without reasonable excuse to comply with the terms of a notice under section 58(1) of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976
to return a plate or disc within 7 days of the service on you of the notice

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) On conviction, an authorised officer of the council or constable shall be entitled to remove and retain the plate or disc from the said hackney carriage or private hire vehicle - section 58(2)(b) of the Act
